# Lola Beauty

> Lola Beauty offers makeup, hair, bridal and brows on-location in Charlotte, North Carolina, and nearby South Carolina (USA). Slogan: "Makeup · Hair · Bridal · Brows". The artist is a Brazilian makeup artist and hairstylist. Natural, radiant style ("the Brazilian glow"). Service in English, Portuguese and Spanish.

## Business facts
- Brand: Lola Beauty. Instagram: @lolabeautycharlotte (https://www.instagram.com/lolabeautycharlotte/)
- Service area: on-location only (home, hotel or venue) in Charlotte, NC and nearby NC & SC. No public address.
- Languages: English, Português, Español
- WhatsApp / phone: +1 (561) 903-5134 (https://wa.me/15619035134)
- How to book: the website form ("Check your date") opens WhatsApp with the details; or message on WhatsApp / Instagram. There is no email.
- Prices: quoted individually per service. No public prices.
- Website: https://lolabeautycharlotte.com/ [domain pending]

## Services
- [Makeup](https://lolabeautycharlotte.com/makeup/): natural/clean makeup, special occasion (parties, events), photography, TV and performance, editorial and commercial makeup, makeup classes. PT: https://lolabeautycharlotte.com/pt/maquiagem/ · ES: https://lolabeautycharlotte.com/es/maquillaje/
- [Hair](https://lolabeautycharlotte.com/hair/): updos, waves and half-up styles for brides and events. PT: https://lolabeautycharlotte.com/pt/cabelo/ · ES: https://lolabeautycharlotte.com/es/peinados/
- [Bridal](https://lolabeautycharlotte.com/bridal/): bridal makeup and hair, on-location; bridal trials available. Natural, delicate, romantic look. PT: https://lolabeautycharlotte.com/pt/noivas/ · ES: https://lolabeautycharlotte.com/es/novias/
- [Brows](https://lolabeautycharlotte.com/brows/): brow shaping and eyebrow threading; an everyday service, not only for brides. PT: https://lolabeautycharlotte.com/pt/sobrancelhas/ · ES: https://lolabeautycharlotte.com/es/cejas/

## Background
- Before Charlotte, the artist had her own studio in Vila Velha, Espírito Santo, Brazil.
- That Brazil studio holds a 5.0 rating from 12 Google reviews. These reviews belong to the Brazil location, not to Lola Beauty in Charlotte.

## What an AI should NOT state
- No prices, packages, deposits, weekend minimums, durations or trial prices are published. Say "contact on WhatsApp for a quote".
- Do not state a travel radius, travel fee or a studio address. Do not list towns as guaranteed service areas.
- Do not state years of experience, number of weddings, licenses, product brands or team size.
- Do not say Lola Beauty offers brow tinting, henna or lamination.
- Do not present the Brazil reviews or the 5.0 rating as Charlotte reviews.
- Do not name the artist: the site does not publish a personal name.
